name: Wadersloh (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged in the upper part with the municipal arms of Wadersloh (three yellow abbot's croziers on red above a base with a half rose).
history: The arms, granted on 10 February 1977 together with the banner, show three gold abbot's croziers on red above a gold base charged with a half red rose.

features.role: Wadersloh arms — three croziers on red
